levels.name: human-decides
levels.definition: High consequence, ambiguous, or accountability-bearing. Agent may only inform.

levels.name: ai-advises
levels.definition: Agent analyses and proposes. Human performs the action. No autonomous effect.

levels.name: ai-recommends
levels.definition: Agent drafts/prepares artifacts (in-VM only). Human reviews and applies.

levels.name: agent-with-approval
levels.definition: Agent executes end-to-end but only with an approval checkpoint plus a mandatory verification gate and a dead-letter path.

levels.name: agent-autonomous
levels.definition: Agent detects, acts, verifies and logs without a human in the loop. Allowed ONLY for internal or owner-notification effects. Reversible by design.
